messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: (first) release candidate lavaan 0.6-1
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

I have rolled up a 'release candidate' for lavaan 0.6-1. To install this version, type in R:

install.packages("lavaan", repos="http://www.da.ugent.be", type="source")

and it should be version 0.6-1.1239 (or higher). Please give it a try and reply to this thread to report any issues.

If you want to 'return' to the current CRAN version (0.5-23), you can just type

install.packages("lavaan")

again (and restart your R session), so it is perfectly safe to try out a dev version.

What is new?

- two-level SEM (continuous data, random intercepts only). Documentation
is on its way, but for now, see the following set of slides (eg slide 62
+ 63):

http://users.ugent.be/~yrosseel/lavaan/zurich2017/MULTILEVEL/lavaan_multilevel_zurich2017.pdf

- a complete rewrite of the code to compute (robust) standard errors and
(robust) test statistics; the code is now much more consistent, but this
may result in small changes in the values of some robust test statistics
as printed in the output of summary(); a meanstructure is no longer
added automatically

- conditional.x = FALSE works in the categorical case

- if fixed.x = TRUE, we compute the loglikelihood without the exogenous
covariates, and we do not allow for missing values in the exogenous
covariates when missing = "ml"

- estimator = "PML" now works for continuous-only data, or mixed
continuous/ordinal data

- many, many small changes under the hood.


If no major issues are found, we will upload lavaan 0.6-1 in a week or so.

Yves.

messages.author: 572119bb37de95d7
messages.subject: (first) release candidate lavaan 0.6-1
parts:
Thank you for this wonderful development of lavaan.

The description refers to multilevel SEM, saying
- continuous data, random intercepts only

Adding multilevel estimations of categorical data (or adding random slopes) in a free package is of course a huge task (in particular if a single person does nearly all the work). But may I still ask whether such a development for lavaan (and blavaan) is on any to do list for lavaan/blavaan?

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: (first) release candidate lavaan 0.6-1
parts:
It is. Eventually, lavaan will be able to handle multilevel SEM with categorical data. But it takes time. And over the years, I learned I should not make any promises of when something will be available.

Yves.
